question.text: Under the SEBI (PIT) Regulations, 2015, a concern, firm, trust, HUF, company or AOP wherein a director of a company, or his relative, or the banker of the company has more than what percentage holding or interest is deemed to be a connected person?

explanation.text: The Logic: The deeming provision in the PIT Regulations covers a concern, firm, trust, HUF, company or AOP wherein a director of a company, or his relative, or the banker of the company has more than 10% of the holding or interest. Such an entity is deemed a connected person under the PIT Regulations. The Trap: 5% is the trigger for substantial-acquisition disclosure under the Takeover Regulations, not for the connected-person deeming test. The PIT threshold is "more than 10%". Note: The deeming is a rebuttable presumption — the entity can establish that, on the facts, it is not actually a connected person.
